date.as_written: saṃvat 1695 varṣe śāke 1550 pravarttamāne uttarāyanagate (!) śrīsūrye vasaṃta〈r〉ṛtau śrīphālgunamāse (!) śuklapakṣe paṃcamī bhaumavāsare

notes: The catalogue lists Haraprasāda as scribe, but the text reads 'medapāṭhajñātīyabhaṭanaraharaprasādāt (!) bhagavānena ... likhitaṃ', suggesting Bhagavāna is the scribe in connection with Bhaṭa Naraharaprasāda of the Mewar (Medapāṭha) Brahmin community. There is a 10-year discrepancy between the two given years: VS 1695 corresponds to ~1638 CE, whereas ŚS 1550 corresponds to ~1628 CE.
